question.title: The nature and extent of sacred doctrine

audioFile: 01 - 01 - Prologue; Question 1 The Nature and Extent of Sacred Doctrine.mp3

method.pipeline: transformers.js (@huggingface/transformers) ASR pipeline, Whisper base.en, CPU (wasm) backend
method.boundaryMethod: regex search for narrator-read ordinal + 'article' (e.g. 'Second article') in ASR transcript chunks; timestamp linearly interpolated by character offset within the matched ~30s chunk
method.note: Word-level timestamps were NOT computed in this pilot (scope was reduced mid-task to article-level boundaries only, per updated instructions). Chunk-level timestamps interpolated by char-position give boundary precision of roughly +/-2-4 seconds, not word-level precision.

timing.notes: CPU-only (WASM). GPU/DirectML (device:'dml') was attempted per request but hung indefinitely on a 15s test clip with the tiny model and was aborted after ~3 min; not pursued further given the CPU path already runs well under realtime.
